title: Exceptional base change for towers and integral coefficients
statement:
Fix the global finite-field datum: $k$ is the fixed algebraic closure of a finite field of characteristic $p$, and $\ell\ne p$ is prime [def-weil-finite-field-fiber]. Let $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ be a finite extension with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$, and put $A_n=\mathcal O_E/\ell^n$ for $n\geq1$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $X,Y,Y'$ be separated finite-type $k$-schemes, let $f:X\to Y$ be smooth separated of pure relative dimension $d\geq0$, and let $v:Y'\to Y$ be any $k$-morphism [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting, def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. Set $X'=X\times_Y Y'$ with projections $u:X'\to X$ and $f':X'\to Y'$, so $fu=vf'$; use a compactification $f=pj$ and its pullback for $f'$ [def-cbc-compact-support-square]. No smoothness, flatness or properness of $v$ is assumed.

Use the ordinary derived categories of varying-coefficient strict towers and their uniformly bounded constructible finite-Tor subcategories $\Dctf(-_{\mathrm{proét}},\mathcal O_E/\ell^\bullet)$; normalization means that every derived reduction map is invertible [sk-def-sp-coefficient-towers, sk-def-sp-normalized-towers]. Tower pullback is exact levelwise finite constant-ring pullback [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations, prop-weil-pbc-proetale-constant-exact]; $Rf_{!,\bullet}$ and $f^!_\bullet$ mean [det-sp-tower-shriek-levels, det-sp-tower-gluing]. Finite exceptional base change means the counit transpose of inverse compact-support exchange [lem-pur-smb-extraordinary, det-sp-mixed-base-change]. At integral coefficients use the completed coefficient sheaf, derived-complete constructible category and completed pullback [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients, def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed, def-pur-integral-derived-operations]. The integral exceptional functor is the right adjoint of [prop-coef-integral-exceptional-adjoint], identified counit-preservingly with $H_f$ of [det-sp-integral-adjunction-bijection]. Then: 

1. extension by zero and proper base change give a natural isomorphism
   $\beta_{f,\bullet}:v_\bullet^*Rf_{!,\bullet}\xrightarrow{\sim}R(f')_{!,\bullet}u_\bullet^*$ of
   functors $\Dctf(X_{\mathrm{proét}},\mathcal O_E/\ell^\bullet)\to\Dctf(Y'_{\mathrm{proét}},\mathcal O_E/\ell^\bullet)$;
2. the transpose of $v_\bullet^*(\varepsilon_{f,\bullet})\circ\beta_{f,\bullet}^{-1}$ under
   the tower adjunction for $f'$ is a natural isomorphism
   $e_{f,\bullet}:u_\bullet^*f_\bullet^!\xrightarrow{\sim}(f')_\bullet^!v_\bullet^*$, whose level $n$
   is the finite exceptional base change $e_{f,\mathcal O_E/\ell^n}$, and which is
   compatible with the reduction maps (hence preserves normalized towers);
3. for $E=\Ql$ and $K\in\Dbc(Y,\Zl)$, $R\varprojlim$ of $e_{f,\bullet}(\operatorname{red}_YK)$ is
   an isomorphism $u_{\Zl}^*f^!_{\Zl}K\xrightarrow{\sim}(f')^!_{\Zl}v^*_{\Zl}K$ in
   $\Dbc(X',\Zl)$, the integral exceptional base change, that is, the transpose under
   $R(f')_{!,\Zl}\dashv(f')^!_{\Zl}$ of $v_{\Zl}^*(\varepsilon_{f,\Zl}(K))\circ\beta_{f,\Zl}(f^!_{\Zl}K)^{-1}$.
   Here the integral compact-support base change
   $\beta_{f,\Zl}(M):v_{\Zl}^*Rf_{!,\Zl}M\xrightarrow{\sim}R(f')_{!,\Zl}u_{\Zl}^*M$ ($M\in\Dbc(X,\Zl)$)
   is the coefficient transport of $\beta_{f,\bullet}(\operatorname{red}_XM)$: the unique map whose
   reduction, under the reduction identifications for $Rf_{!,\Zl}$ of
   [det-sp-integral-direct-image-tower] and the reconstruction counit for completed pullback, is
   $\beta_{f,\bullet}(\operatorname{red}_XM)$; it exists and is unique by the equivalence
   [det-sp-normalized-equivalence].

proof.text: Apply [lem-sp-ctf-tower-pullback-reconstruction] to $u,v$ and all four schemes: the tower inputs are bounded below with finite etale-origin evaluations, and pullback preserves their uniform ctf bounds and normalization. The pullback compactification exists by [def-cbc-compact-support-square]; $f'$ has relative dimension $d$ by [lem-sbc-smooth-relative-dimension-permanence](1).

The actual compactification exchange of [det-sp-tower-shriek-levels](2b) applies to these inputs. Its ctf restriction and finite evaluations are those of [lem-sp-tower-mate-evaluation-reduction]. This proves clause (1), with the tower adjunctions of [det-sp-tower-gluing].

Construct $q_K=v_\bullet^*\varepsilon_{f,K}\circ\beta(G_fK)^{-1}$ and its transpose $e_K$ under the adjunction for $f'$. By [lem-sp-tower-mate-evaluation-reduction], $e$ is natural and evaluates to the finite counit transpose. Each evaluation is invertible by [lem-pur-smb-extraordinary], with $A_n=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^{en}$ since $\ell$ is a unit times $\varpi_E^e$. Its hypotheses are the same smooth square and finite ctf input. Conservativity [det-sp-tower-shriek-levels](3) makes this already constructed tower map invertible.

The explicit reduction equation of [lem-sp-tower-mate-evaluation-reduction] proves compatibility including the input transition for every quotient $A_n\to A_m$. For normalized $K$, [det-sp-tower-gamma](3) and Step 1 normalize $u_\bullet^*G_fK$. The reduction square and invertibility of $e_n,e_m$ then make every reduction of $G_{f'}v_\bullet^*K$ invertible. This proves clause (2).

For $E=\mathbf Q_\ell$, [lem-sp-integral-exceptional-mate-transport] identifies the integral right adjoints counit-preservingly and supplies the whole-tower comparisons $a_K,b_K$. Reconstruct $t_K=e_{r_YK}$ by its displayed formula for $T_K$; this is $R\varprojlim e_{r_YK}$ under those comparisons. The unit comparisons are isomorphisms and a functor sends inverse pairs to inverse pairs, so $T_K$ is invertible. The defining transpose equation for $e$ is exactly that lemma's hypothesis. Its integral counit equation makes $T_K$ the claimed integral exceptional transpose, for precisely the coefficient-transported $\beta_{f,\mathbf Z_\ell}$ specified in the unchanged statement. This proves clause (3).

statement_correction.what: The imported statement has unbound f,u,v,f′,X,Y,Y′,ell and no domain beyond “as in the sketch”, so it is not a self-contained proposition. For example, without smoothness the claimed exceptional base-change conclusion need not hold, and without finite type the chosen compact-support interfaces are unavailable. The corrected preamble copies the unit and purity standing context, retains arbitrary v in that context and every original conclusion, and distinguishes ordinary finite tower coefficients from completed integral coefficients.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q129-1e4d318e5 (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: Re-split checked against the live 7-step proof, which was reviewed 2026-10-17, is still live and is not superseded. The statement and stmt_deps are byte-identical. All seven old steps are retained verbatim in the report. Each old argument is now either a clause of a new node or an explicit sentence in the assembly. A = pullback domains, étale origin, Tor and cohomology intervals, tensor-pullback, and α as the reconstruction counit κ. B = e=G'(q)η, finite evaluation, and the r^P/r^Q reduction square through the second identity of det-sp-mixed-base-change plus naturality (recomputed). C = counit-preserving δ via det-sp-unique-right-adjoint, T=ι^{-1}L(b^{-1}ta)ι, and the transpose-reduction implication by faithfulness. The assembly keeps three things: smb-extraordinary at O_E/ϖ^{en} with shriek-levels(3) conservativity applied after construction, normalization via gamma(3)+A, and inverse pairs. The assembly is 2271 characters. The three nodes (2568/3157/4126 characters) are comparable and none restates the item, since B and C exclude invertibility. Small cases checked: n=m, v=id, t=0, K=0, empty schemes, d=0. No duplicate candidates: lem-pur-integral-operations-preserve-constructible is only a partial overlap with A, and lem-pod-integral-pullback-system-comparison, lem-fd-whole-tower-integral-pullback-comparison, gluing, mixed-base-change, adjunction-bijection and purity-bc-factors all differ. Batch-5 finding: every listed citation is a det-sp tower node already in the item's reviewed closure; det-sp-reduction-exceptional is a stmt_dep of gluing. The reached trf/pod nodes (right-fraction calculus, Leray chain formula, functorial flat resolution, ϖ-regularity) are generic and are not trace-formula or Poincaré-duality steps, so they are accepted. Tool use lem-sbc-smooth-relative-dimension-permanence is accepted. The other split_report tool_uses are now uncited by the item; this is advisory, and the workers on A and C should declare them. No SGA is cited.
